scripts.dev:e2e: node scripts/write-e2e-dev-vars.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env e2e && wrangler dev --env e2e
scripts.dev:assets: pnpm --filter web build && node scripts/write-e2e-dev-vars.mjs && cp .dev.vars.e2e .dev.vars.assets && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env assets && wrangler dev --env assets --port 8788
scripts.build:prod: pnpm --filter web build && pnpm run check:release && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env prod --outdir dist
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm --filter web build && pnpm run check:release && wrangler deploy --env prod
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env prod
